description: '''Italian occult psychedelia''' (also known as '''psichedelia occulta italiana''') is a subgenre of Italian [[psychedelic music]] defined as a form of [[Hauntology (music)|hauntology]], capturing the Italian [[collective memory]] of the soundtracks to [[Cannibal film|cannibal movies]], [[Spaghetti Western|spaghetti westerns]], and [[B movie|B horror movies]]. "Psichedelia occulta italiana" was coined by journalist Antonio Ciarletta in an article published by Italian music magazine ''Blow Up'', in January 2012. A festival called Thalassa has occurred in Rome since 2013 to celebrate Italian occult psychedelia bands.{{Psychedelic sidebar|Arts}}
